question: What divine status is affirmed for one who wears the armor on the body?
premises: The armor may be worn on the neck or right arm.
The wearer is identified as Viṣṇu.
The verse explicitly denies any doubt about this.
inference: The wearer of the armor is indeed Viṣṇu without doubt.
plain_english: Whether worn on the neck or on the right arm, he too is Viṣṇu; there is no doubt.
